title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 11: the men at the east gate, the cauldron and the meat, and the promise of a heart of flesh.

questions.text: Where did the Spirit bring the prophet at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: The Spirit lifted him up and brought him to the east gate of Yahweh's house, which looks eastward.

answers.text: To the east gate of Yahweh's house
To the inner court of the palace
To a valley full of dry bones
To the gate of the city of Babylon

questions.text: What did the men say the city was?
questions.explanation: They said, 'The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.'

questions.text: What had they filled the streets of the city with?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says they had multiplied their slain in the city and filled its streets with the slain.

questions.text: Into whose hands would Yahweh deliver them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will bring them out of the middle of the city and deliver them into the hands of strangers.

answers.text: The hands of their own princes

questions.text: Where does Yahweh say he will judge them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says they will fall by the sword and that he will judge them in the border of Israel.

questions.text: What happened while the prophet was prophesying?
questions.explanation: When he prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died, and the prophet fell down on his face.

answers.text: The twenty-five men fled from the gate
Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died
Jaazaniah the son of Azzur was struck blind
The gate of the house was shut

questions.text: What would Yahweh be to those he had scattered among the countries?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that, though he scattered them, he would be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they had come.

answers.text: A consuming fire in the countries
A sanctuary for a little while

questions.text: What kind of heart would Yahweh give them in place of the stony heart?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will take the stony heart out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh.

questions.text: According to verse 20, what would they become to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Those who walk in his statutes and keep his ordinances will be his people, and he will be their God.

answers.text: A kingdom of priests for the nations
His people, and he would be their God
Kings over the countries around them

questions.text: Where did the Spirit bring the prophet in the vision at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: The Spirit lifted him up and brought him in the vision into Chaldea, to the captives, and then the vision went up from him.

answers.text: To the mountain east of the city
